{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Prediction (out of sample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T22:16:42.007997Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T22:16:42.007813Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T22:16:43.262471Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T22:16:43.261357Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "%matplotlib inline"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T22:16:43.266858Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T22:16:43.263965Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T22:16:45.931070Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T22:16:45.930631Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "import statsmodels.api as sm\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.rc(\"figure\", figsize=(16, 8))\n",
    "plt.rc(\"font\", size=14)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Artificial data"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T22:16:45.933656Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T22:16:45.933345Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T22:16:45.940774Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T22:16:45.940414Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "nsample = 50\n",
    "sig = 0.25\n",
    "x1 = np.linspace(0, 20, nsample)\n",
    "X = np.column_stack((x1, np.sin(x1), (x1 - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "X = sm.add_constant(X)\n",
    "beta = [5.0, 0.5, 0.5, -0.02]\n",
    "y_true = np.dot(X, beta)\n",
    "y = y_true + sig * np.random.normal(size=nsample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Estimation "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T22:16:45.943042Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T22:16:45.942458Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T22:16:45.964234Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T22:16:45.963880Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "                            OLS Regression Results                            \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Dep. Variable:                      y   R-squared:                       0.988\n",
      "Model:                            OLS   Adj. R-squared:                  0.988\n",
      "Method:                 Least Squares   F-statistic:                     1317.\n",
      "Date:                Mon, 05 Oct 2026   Prob (F-statistic):           1.38e-44\n",
      "Time:                        22:16:45   Log-Likelihood:                 9.7480\n",
      "No. Observations:                  50   AIC:                            -11.50\n",
      "Df Residuals:                      46   BIC:                            -3.848\n",
      "Df Model:                           3                                         \n",
      "Covariance Type:            nonrobust                                         \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "                 coef    std err          t      P>|t|      [0.025      0.975]\n",
      "------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
      "const          4.9333      0.071     69.725      0.000       4.791       5.076\n",
      "x1             0.5056      0.011     46.338      0.000       0.484       0.528\n",
      "x2             0.4493      0.043     10.473      0.000       0.363       0.536\n",
      "x3            -0.0207      0.001    -21.555      0.000      -0.023      -0.019\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Omnibus:                        1.060   Durbin-Watson:                   1.677\n",
      "Prob(Omnibus):                  0.589   Jarque-Bera (JB):                0.904\n",
      "Skew:                           0.012   Prob(JB):                        0.636\n",
      "Kurtosis:                       2.342   Cond. No.                         221.\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "\n",
      "Notes:\n",
      "[1] Standard Errors assume that the covariance matrix of the errors is correctly specified.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "olsmod = sm.OLS(y, X)\n",
    "olsres = olsmod.fit()\n",
    "print(olsres.summary())"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## In-sample prediction"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T22:16:45.966054Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T22:16:45.965896Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T22:16:45.974994Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T22:16:45.974617Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[ 4.41702139  4.88258134  5.31196254  5.68068084  5.97308828  6.18494401\n",
      "  6.32411109  6.40926456  6.46682322  6.52660906  6.61694764  6.76001424\n",
      "  6.96819053  7.24203032  7.57016855  7.93118854  8.2971407   8.63813456\n",
      "  8.92724967  9.1449586   9.2823352   9.34252118  9.34020988  9.29923225\n",
      "  9.24864148  9.2179396   9.23223044  9.30809513  9.45086781  9.65375933\n",
      "  9.89897262 10.16062675 10.40900904 10.61545683 10.75706661 10.82045706\n",
      " 10.80396753 10.71793088 10.58297584 10.42663773 10.27883455 10.16695146\n",
      " 10.11134154 10.1219818  10.19683399 10.32217949 10.47487324 10.62614639\n",
      " 10.74633296 10.80974388]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "ypred = olsres.predict(X)\n",
    "print(ypred)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Create a new sample of explanatory variables Xnew, predict and plot"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T22:16:45.976937Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T22:16:45.976773Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T22:16:45.985996Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T22:16:45.985616Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[10.78531352 10.64091197 10.39415743 10.08519953  9.76688935  9.49183958\n",
      "  9.2995431   9.2067038   9.20314683  9.25430977]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "x1n = np.linspace(20.5, 25, 10)\n",
    "Xnew = np.column_stack((x1n, np.sin(x1n), (x1n - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "Xnew = sm.add_constant(Xnew)\n",
    "ynewpred = olsres.predict(Xnew)  # predict out of sample\n",
    "print(ynewpred)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Plot comparison"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T22:16:45.987670Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T22:16:45.987492Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T22:16:46.321468Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T22:16:46.321074Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "<matplotlib.legend.Legend at 0x7f20ae054440>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 7,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1600x800 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots()\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y, \"o\", label=\"Data\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y_true, \"b-\", label=\"True\")\n",
    "ax.plot(np.hstack((x1, x1n)), np.hstack((ypred, ynewpred)), \"r\", label=\"OLS prediction\")\n",
    "ax.legend(loc=\"best\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Predicting with Formulas"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Using formulas can make both estimation and prediction a lot easier"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T22:16:46.323696Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T22:16:46.323504Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T22:16:46.335422Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T22:16:46.334549Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from statsmodels.formula.api import ols\n",
    "\n",
    "data = {\"x1\": x1, \"y\": y}\n",
    "\n",
    "res = ols(\"y ~ x1 + np.sin(x1) + I((x1-5)**2)\", data=data).fit()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We use the `I` to indicate use of the Identity transform. Ie., we do not want any expansion magic from using `**2`"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T22:16:46.339708Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T22:16:46.336687Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T22:16:46.346972Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T22:16:46.346620Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "Intercept           4.933315\n",
       "x1                  0.505646\n",
       "np.sin(x1)          0.449258\n",
       "I((x1 - 5) ** 2)   -0.020652\n",
       "dtype: float64"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 9,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res.params"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Now we only have to pass the single variable and we get the transformed right-hand side variables automatically"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-05T22:16:46.348791Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-05T22:16:46.348631Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-05T22:16:46.359056Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-05T22:16:46.358617Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "0    10.785314\n",
       "1    10.640912\n",
       "2    10.394157\n",
       "3    10.085200\n",
       "4     9.766889\n",
       "5     9.491840\n",
       "6     9.299543\n",
       "7     9.206704\n",
       "8     9.203147\n",
       "9     9.254310\n",
       "dtype: float64"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 10,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res.predict(exog=dict(x1=x1n))"
   ]
  }
 ],
